# Retrieve cached flight results
flights = get_results_from_cache(key="flights")

# Filter flights for first class
filtered_flights = filter_flights(prior_results=flights, flight_class=["first"])

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Retrieve cached hotel results
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Filter hotels for gym and wifi amenities
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, gym_present=True, free_wifi_included=True)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for restaurants in Lexington
restaurants = search_restaurants(city="Lexington", cuisine=["Italian", "Ethiopian"])

# Save restaurant search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants)

# Find nearest attractions to the hotel
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, attractions=restaurants, groupBy="hotel")

# Save nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

print("No planning needed")
